page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 31.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a high memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU, designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

This instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage options. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-highmem-4 offers a dense memory profile within a low-vCPU footprint, allowing organizations to run memory-sensitive applications without paying for unnecessary compute cores. This resource balance makes the instance suitable for small to medium databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and lightweight data processing pipelines that demand a larger memory footprint than standard general-purpose instances.
